body: We discussed this at autoscaling sync this morning (thanks @henningandersen for raising this issue) and decided to go with option 2, with input from @jasontedor

issue.title: Make disk.threshold_enabled operator only

labels.name: :Distributed/Allocation
labels.description: All issues relating to the decision making around placing a shard (both master logic & on the nodes)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Orchestrated environments should not allow users to override
`cluster.routing.allocation.disk.threshold_enabled`, so making this
operator only.

Closes #77846
